lines.lyric: Neoneun nae salme dashi tteun haetbit
lines.lyric_hangul: 너는 내 삶에 다시 뜬 햇빛
lines.lyric_translation: You’re the sun that rose again in my life
A reincarnation of my childhood dreams
I don’t know what these emotions are
Am I still dreaming?
There’s a green oasis in a desert

lines.lyric: Nae an gipeun gose a priori
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 안 깊은 곳의 a priori
lines.lyric_translation: A priori deep inside of me
I’m so happy, I can’t breathe
My surroundings are getting more and more transparent
I hear the ocean from far away
Across the dream, past the woods
I’m going to the place that’s getting clearer
Take my hands now

lines.lyric: You are the cause of my euphoria
lines.lyric_hangul: You are the cause of my euphoria
lines.lyric_translation: You are the cause of my euphoria
Euphoria
Take my hands now

lines.lyric: You are the cause of my euphoria
lines.lyric_hangul: You are the cause of my euphoria
lines.lyric_translation: You are the cause of my euphoria
Euphoria

lines.lyric: When I’m with you I’m in utopia
lines.lyric_hangul: When I'm with you, I'm in utopia
lines.lyric_translation: When I’m with you I’m in utopia

lines.lyric_hangul: 너도 나처럼 지워진 꿈을 찾아 헤맸을까?
lines.lyric_translation: Were you wandering around / Looking for an erased dream too?
It’s different from the typical definition of destiny

lines.lyric: Apeun neoye nunbichi nawa gateun goseul boneun geol
lines.lyric_hangul: 아픈 너의 눈빛이 나와 같은 곳을 보는 걸
lines.lyric_translation: Your pained eyes are looking at the same place as me
